title: The Simplest Common Sense
simplified_paragraphs: 大学生们在公园聊天，有一个人问：”一滴水如果从很高的地方落下来，会不会把人砸死？”
大家想了很多办法去计算，用了近一个小时，还是没有计算出来。
有一个人路过时听到了他们的谈话，就问：”你们没有看见过雨吗？雨能砸死人吗？”
这时，学生们发现自己忘记了最简单的常识。
traditional_paragraphs: 大學生們在公園聊天，有一個人問：”一滴水如果從很高的地方落下來，會不會把人砸死？”
大家想了很多辦法去計算，用了近一個小時，還是沒有計算出來。
有一個人路過時聽到了他們的談話，就問：”你們沒有看見過雨嗎？雨能砸死人嗎？”
這時，學生們發現自己忘記了最簡單的常識。
pinyin_paragraphs: dà xué shēng men zài gōng yuán liáo tiān， yǒu yī gè rén wèn：” yī dī shuǐ rú guǒ cóng hěn gāo de dì fang luò xià lái， huì bù huì bǎ rén zá sǐ？”
dà jiā xiǎng le hěn duō bàn fǎ qù jì suàn， yòng le jìn yī gè xiǎo shí， hái shi méi yǒu jì suàn chu lai。
yǒu yī gè rén lù guò shí tīng dào le tā men de tán huà， jiù wèn：” nǐ men méi yǒu kàn jiàn guo yǔ ma？ yǔ néng zá sǐ rén ma？”
zhè shí， xué shēng men fā xiàn zì jǐ wàng jì le zuì jiǎn dān de cháng shí。
english_paragraphs: Some college students were chatting in a park when one of them asked, “If a drop of water fell from a great height, could it kill someone?”
They tried all sorts of ways to calculate the answer, but after nearly an hour, they still hadn't worked it out.
A passerby overheard their conversation and asked, “Haven't you ever seen rain? Can rain kill someone by hitting them?”
At that moment, the students realized they had forgotten the simplest common sense.
english_full:
Some college students were chatting in a park when one of them asked, “If a drop of water fell from a great height, could it kill someone?”

They tried all sorts of ways to calculate the answer, but after nearly an hour, they still hadn't worked it out.

A passerby overheard their conversation and asked, “Haven't you ever seen rain? Can rain kill someone by hitting them?”

At that moment, the students realized they had forgotten the simplest common sense.
